import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
for n in ['words','clean','cliques']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources'/ (n+'.pdf')),'-'],text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/'+n+'.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print(n,'CHARS',len(r.stdout))
print('CLIQUES FULL',Path('sources/cliques.txt').read_text())
print('WORDS SECTIONS');s=Path('sources/words.txt').read_text();print(s[:6500]);print(s[s.find('5.'):][-24000:])
